title: Intratumoral NK Cell and ILC Landscape
description: In this study, total innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), including natural killer (NK) cells, were FACS-sorted from eight dissociated primary head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) tumors. In addition, ILCs and NK cells were sorted from peripheral blood of tumor patients. The ILCs and NK cells were analyzed by single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) using the Smart-seq2 approach.
